channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Protestors snatched loud-hailer, broke barricades: FIR documents demolition violence in Delhi
item.description: The unruly elements were asked not to assemble at the spot as Section 163 (applied in cases of nuisance or apprehended danger) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was in place, and they should disperse quickly, but the crowd instead of relenting, became more aggressive, escalated sloganeering and started pelting stones at the police personnel.

item.title: From AI PCs to edge eomputing: What really mattered at CES 2026
item.description: CES 2026 highlighted a shift toward on-device AI, edge computing, creator-focused hardware, and deeper hardware-software integration as the next phase of consumer technology.

item.title: YRF calls Dhurandhar "new benchmark of Indian cinema"; Ranveer Singh reacts with wholesome reply
item.description: Ranveer Singh starrer Dhurandhar has collected more than Rs 1,247 crore at the worldwide box office. Dhurandhar 2 is expected to release on March 19, 2026.

item.title: Bharti Singh resumes Laughter Chefs shoot two weeks after giving birth, distributes sweets to paps [reactions]
item.description: Comedian and host Bharti Singh, who welcomed her second child two weeks ago, is back on the Laughter Chefs 3 sets. During a light-hearted moment when a pap, they joked about a third child. Bharti quipped, "Yahi karti rahun ab? Shooting bhi hoti hai na," (Should I just keep having kids? I have shoots too)

item.title: Venezuela to buy only US-made goods under oil deal: Trump
item.description: He said the purchases will include "American Agricultural Products, and American Made Medicines, Medical Devices, and Equipment," as well as technology and hardware to improve Venezuela's electricity grid and energy facilities.

item.title: Washington steps up action against 'illicit oil trade', seizes Russian-linked tanker, dark fleet ship
item.description: "I believe you're referring to the Bella 1 tanker that was seized this morning," Leavitt told reporters. "The Department of Justice and the Department of Homeland Security, in coordination with the Department of War did announce that seizure this morning for violation of US sanctions."

item.title: Delhi air quality improves to 'poor' category, national capital reels under icy cold conditions
item.description: However, air quality remained very poor in several parts of the city. Nehru Nagar recorded the worst air quality in Delhi with an AQI of 344, followed by Anand Vihar at 337 and Jahangirpuri at 332. R.K. Puram also remained in the very poor category with an AQI of 326.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower over weak global cues
item.description: Main broad-cap indices performed almost in line with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 down 0.32 per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 lost 0.14 per cent.

item.title: Farrhana Bhatt, Ayaan Lall dance together; remain inseparable at BB success party in Dubai
item.description: All eyes were on Ayaan Lall and Farrhana Bhatt as they remained inseparable at the Bigg Boss success party hosted by Danube Properties in Dubai.

item.title: 'Deeply shocking': PM Modi condoles untimely passing of Agnivesh Agarwal
item.description: PM Modi replied to his post, saying, "The untimely passing of Shri Agnivesh Agarwal is deeply shocking and saddening. The depth of your grief is evident in this touching tribute. Praying that you and your family find continued strength and courage. Om Shanti."
